about.title: About me
about.description: Welcome to the about me page
about.about_me:
Hi, my name is Martin and I love building software that helps people. My interest in programming started with a dream to create my own game. Although I haven't managed that yet, it led me down a path of programming that I've been on for over 5 years.

I'm interested in robotics and space technology, which led me to study robotics at the Slovak University of Technology in Bratislava. Alongside work and studies, I dedicate time to weightlifting and climbing.
about.timeline.title: Timeline
about.timeline.sections.0.title: First lines of code
about.timeline.sections.0.description: In 2019, I started programming for the first time and learned the basics of programming in Python. After entering high school, I started to devote myself intensively to programming and web development.
about.timeline.sections.1.title: Started coding consistently
about.timeline.sections.1.description: Experimented with multiple languages, game engines, and frameworks. Started exploring ways to make my code cleaner and efficient.
about.timeline.sections.2.title: Got Job at Binary Confidence s.r.o.
about.timeline.sections.2.description: Got my first job as a backend developer in Binary Confidence s.r.o. Worked with technologies such as Ansible, Hyper-V, Linux, etc.. Met with new concepts, technologies, interesting projects, and great people, furthering my knowledge.
about.timeline.sections.3.title: Graduated highschool
about.timeline.sections.3.description: For my graduation project I worked on my own first large-scale fullstack web application. I learned a lot about web development, and I was able to apply my knowledge in a real-world project. I also learned a lot about project architecture, cloud and deployment.

experience.slideshowItems.web_developmen: Vývoj webových aplikácií zahŕňa vytváranie interaktívnych a dynamických webových stránok a aplikácií pomocou technológií ako HTML, CSS, JavaScript a rôzne frameworky ako React, Angular alebo Vue.js.
experience.slideshowItems.mobile_develop: Vývoj mobilných aplikácií zahŕňa vytváranie aplikácií pre mobilné zariadenia, ako sú smartfóny a tablety. Môže zahŕňať natívny vývoj pre iOS a Android, alebo použitie multiplatformových frameworkov ako Flutter.
experience.slideshowItems.game_developme: Vývoj hier zahŕňa tvorbu interaktívnych herných zážitkov pomocou rôznych technológií a nástrojov. Môže zahŕňať programovanie, dizajn, animáciu a zvukovú produkciu.
experience.slideshowItems.dev_ops.title: DevOps
experience.slideshowItems.dev_ops.descri: DevOps je prax, ktorá spája vývojárov a prevádzkový tím s cieľom zlepšiť spoluprácu a efektivitu pri vývoji a nasadzovaní softvéru. Využíva automatizáciu, kontinuálnu integráciu a nasadenie na zlepšenie kvality a rýchlosti dodania softvéru.
experience.title: Work Experience
experience.description: My specialization is mainly in fullstack web application development and their deployment to production on the cloud, but I am also actively involved in other areas such as backend development for applications. Furthermore, I have worked in game and mobile development.
